scraped.scraped_description: You can use GrantNav to search, filter and download data about awarded grants supporting good causes and communities across the UK.

name: GrantNav
tagline: Search, explore and download grants data published by UK funders in the 360Giving Data Standard
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Reliance on voluntary participation by UK funders to publish data
Data quality dependent on funder compliance with 360Giving Data Standard
policy_outcomes: Increased transparency in UK grant funding
Adoption of 360Giving Data Standard by major UK funders
documented_limitations: Data coverage limited to funders who voluntarily publish in 360Giving Data Standard
Data quality varies by funder compliance
failure_modes: Incomplete data coverage due to voluntary participation
Data lag between grant disbursement and publication
political_relevance_summary: GrantNav addresses civic data access and transparency. Search, explore and download grants data published by UK funders in the 360Giving Data Standard.

movement_building_utility.notes: Provides technical infrastructure that other civic tools or services build upon.

generalizability_notes: Could be adapted to other national contexts with localization. Open-source codebase facilitates replication.
